notes: Customer: Corvina Labs (UK-based fintech focused on wealth management search). Primary ask: low-latency, high-recall enterprise search across 20-50M docs with embeddings + reranking stage. Key constraints: EU/UK data residency (data must not leave eu/uk), SOC2 + ISO27001 proof, SSO/SAML integration, KMS for keys, audit logs and 7-year retention for some records. Tech details: prefer a dedicated GPU pool in eu-west-2 or private VPC deployment; interested in model routing to a cheaper int8 variant for non-sensitive queries and a full-precision reranker for top-k scoring. Latency targets: p95 end-to-end rerank <150ms for queries routed in-region (goal), acceptable fallbacks to <300ms cross-region. Throughput: average 800 qps with 2k burst; offline embedding pipeline to process nightly delta (estimated 50k embeddings/day), but initial full reindex ~25M docs. Cost sensitivity: procurement asking for a per-query cost <= $0.006 for production rerank path (including embedding lookup + reranker compute) and clear estimates for committed vs burst pricing. Quote from Head of Search: "We need predictable worst-case latency for UK clients — can't have spikes when EU region has degraded capacity." POC notes: current hosted demo shows good p50 but p95 needs work; SE exploring prefix/KV caching, batching windows, and reranker quantization. Legal: wants explicit data residency addendum and proof of multi-region failover without exfiltrating data. Procurement asked for a sample SLA clause for latency and a backstop plan if dedicated capacity is impacted. Next-step owner: Ravi to run optimized POC in dedicated eu-west-2 cluster with two model variants + fallback routing; Maeve to coordinate pricing deck and draft DPA addendum.
